newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's ASE Test to buy Malaysia unit.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's ASE Test to buy Malaysia unit.

text.p: Taiwan's U.S.-listed ASE Test Ltd said on Monday it would acquire 100 percent of ASE Malaysia from Taiwan parent company ASE Inc in a transaction worth US$98.44 million.
All three are integrated-circuit testing firms.
The acquisition was expected to be completed by mid-March, the purchasing company said in a statement.
Following completion of the acquisition, ASE Inc will own 82 percent of ASE Test, up from the current 76 percent, it said.

ASE, the first Taiwan firm to list directly in the U.S. over-the-counter Nasdaq National Market, will issue 4.5 million common shares to ASE Inc in exchange for all 71.43 million outstanding shares of ASE Holdings (Singapore) Pte Ltd, the holding company through which ASE Inc owns 100 percent of ASE Malaysia, the statement said.
Based on ASE Test's closing Nasdaq price on February 28, the acquisition value would be US$98.44 million, it said.

"The acqusition of ASE Malaysia fits perfectly into our growth strategy as it adds to our testing capacity, expands our customer base and product mix and provides us with a strong, existing platform to serve one of the fastest growing regions in the global integrated-circuits manufacturing industry, namely Southeast Asia," said ASE Test president David Pan.
ASE Malaysia's IC packaging and testing services are directed to the communications and consumer/industrial electronics market, while ASE focuses on the personal computer market, it said.
